notes.content: ABOUT THE MAJOR This program prepares individuals to manage healthcare operations and services within healthcare facilities and to work as laboratory technicians. The program includes instruction in planning, leadership, ethics, regulations and epidemiology specific to healthcare services. The program also supports students who wish to enter the Healthcare field as nurses or medical assistants. All necessary curriculum to complete the General Education requirements as well as the science pre-requisites for the Nursing, B.S. program are included. ELECTIVE REQUIREMENT Students must select at least 8 units of electives. The list below shows lower division courses only. For a full list of approved electives, please refer to the catalog page. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .
